content: Shared-expense apps increasingly support guest access via shareable/magic links so non-registered participants can view/manage their share without installing an app or creating an account (e.g. SplitCost, Splitceipt). Splitwise itself historically requires adding people by email/phone (creates a shadow account) rather than a pure link-based guest model. Link-based guest access is a differentiator direction some newer competitors lean into, validating the project's planned personal-access-link approach as reasonable and modern, not exotic.
